Owttrim et al. (2022) combine fuel oil, propane and other minor fossil fuels into 'other fossil fuel' (Sect. 3.1). In the archetypes that carry it (the kraft lime kiln) it is mostly heavy fuel oil, with some petroleum coke and propane, so it takes the CER industrial oil price, 22.91 $/GJ (2025, median of the provinces; high 23.07); low the industrial petroleum coke price, 4.44 (EIA SEDS 2024). Propane (16.88) falls inside the range.

Alberta Energy and Minerals Ethane Reference Price, December 2025, 2.71 $/GJ (HHV); range the December values 2010-2025 in 2025 CAD (2024 1.66 to 2010 5.42; 2015 2.84, 2020 3.00), each deflated with the World Bank GDP deflator for Canada. A royalty valuation calculated like the Alberta gas reference price (NGX market price less intra-Alberta transport, times the fuel/loss factor); Alberta ethane is sold to the crackers at about gas cost plus a margin under confidential contracts, so this is a floor for the delivered cost. December 2000 and 2005 (14.9 and 17.6 in 2025 CAD) fall in the high-gas-price years and are left out of the range. Added 2026-10-14 for the ethane-cracker feedstock.
